title: Demo: the opening of a scene

say.text: Test data, not history: a scene is a list of commands, and each spoken line says what it is.
This line is dramatized: invented for the scene, and marked with an open diamond.
(Demo line.) A documented line would carry a filled diamond, and must cite the ledger.

A long speech is split into pages of three lines each, so that nothing is ever cut off by the edge of the box. This one is long enough to need a second page, and the player advances with the confirm key.
The scene ends; the flag has been raised.
